title: North Myrtle Beach Boat Rentals and Charters
specs: Fishing charters target red drum, flounder, trout inshore; king mackerel, cobia, sea bass offshore
Pontoon charters explore Intracoastal Waterway and Bird Island with customizable stops
Private event charters offer customizable routes and professional event coordination
Children of a wide range of ages can enjoy fishing charters, especially inshore trips
Licensed captains operate all fishing charters
Fishing charters accommodate up to 4 or 5 people depending on trip, with additional guests at $100 each, max 5 total
Pontoon and private event charters accommodate up to 8 people flat rate, additional fees for larger parties
Private event charters can host bachelorette parties, birthdays, family reunions, corporate events
includes: Bait, tackle, and safety gear included on fishing charters
Boats equipped with GPS, fish finders, and fishing essentials
Pontoon charters include captain-led guidance and optional add-ons like floating mats and coolers
Private event charters include professional setup for decorations, catering coordination, and music system management

addons.name: Can have 5 passengers total for an additional

gap: Exact age minimum for children not stated
blurb: Guests can book fishing charters ranging from 2-hour kids trips to full-day offshore adventures, pontoon charters for cruising local waterways, and private event charters for celebrations on the water. All trips include necessary gear, professional captains, and customizable options. Locations served include North Myrtle Beach, Myrtle Beach, Surfside Beach, and Murrells Inlet.
extraNote: Prices are all-inclusive and flat rates cover up to 4 or 8 people depending on trip type · Additional guests cost $100 each beyond base group size, maximum 5 for fishing charters, 8 for pontoon and private event charters · Prices increase during peak season June through August · Contact operator for large parties and special arrangements · Private event charters require advance booking and consultation · Departures near Barefoot Landing and Little River Marina in North Myrtle Beach · Year-round with peak season pricing June through August
